entities.name: Marek Jędraszewski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marek Jędraszewski is a Polish Catholic prelate who served as Metropolitan Archbishop of Kraków from 2016 to 2025. He served as Metropolitan Archbishop of Łódź from 2012 to 2017. He has also been vice president of the Polish Episcopal Conference since 2014.
